value.rationale: PASS: The input object is a natural unweighted two-part network with four spectral levels when its parts differ. Fourth-order smoothing can temporarily violate positivity, so exact positive-time recovery and maximum bounded-input amplification are intrinsic robustness quantities. The larger-part-only sharp formula and two distinct spatial recovery times identify a nontrivial orientation-free structural mechanism. In the highly asymmetric regime, recovery, peak and final positivity occur on different power/log scales while amplification vanishes. This distinguishes meaningful behavior not provided by Hilbert contractivity or generic eventual-positivity criteria.
